name: 07-results-post
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished production-quality UI concept board for Uni Companion, university-only React Native Android course study and discussion app. TWO full portrait app screens side-by-side, edge to edge, crisp readable text, minimal neutral gutter, no phone hardware, no perspective, no outside marketing captions. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its cobalt blue primary, white surfaces, navy ink, rounded bold sans-serif headings, readable regular body, tactile rounded buttons with shallow dark-blue bottom edge, icon weight, and original orange star mascot with expressive navy eyes, short arms, cobalt sneakers. Draw new screen layouts. Original art direction, playful consumer quality like Duolingo, not a copy. Clean Android safe areas, generous tap targets, disciplined whitespace, moderate heading sizes. No serif, no cream/forest-green styling, no decorative gradients, no emoji icons, no fake provider logos. Mascot small and purposeful except welcome, never repeated on same screen. Use fictional sample data. LEFT QUIZ RESULTS: title 'That’s progress.', one happy orange star holding a blue pencil, clear central result '4 of 5 correct', small 'Normalization · CSC 301', short encouraging line. Section 'One thing to revisit', expandable question 'What does 3NF remove?' with 'Review explanation' affordance and source p.17. Primary 'Practise missed questions', secondary 'Back to course'. No invented global ranking, no XP or streak dashboard. RIGHT CREATE POST: close, app-bar 'New discussion', Post action visibly disabled until complete. Course selector CSC 301, post type Question selected with Study tip and Discussion alternatives, labelled Title input containing 'Can someone explain transitive dependencies?', body editor with short realistic draft and attachment action. Bottom posting identity control 'Post as Anonymous' with enabled switch and explicit helper 'Classmates won’t see your profile. Moderators can identify your account.' No full-name avatar shown while anonymous. Readable practical keyboard-safe composer.
